title: SemKV: Semantic Mixed-Precision KV Cache Quantization Guided by the Quality Cliff for Long-Context LLM Inference
abstract: arXiv:2608.28911v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: The key-value (KV) cache is the dominant memory bottleneck of long-context large language model (LLM) inference, growing linearly with context length. We show that uniform KV quantization on a fractional-bit grid does not degrade gracefully: under a prespecified multi-seed statistical protocol, Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct with an affine quantizer is statistically indistinguishable from FP16 KV down to 2.322 code bits/value and collapses at 2.0 bits - a quality cliff in (2.0, 2.322] that reappears in generation-time quantization and multi-turn dialogue and transfers to Mistral-7B. The cliff reframes importance-aware mixed precision: above it, eight model-internal importance indicators are statistically interchangeable, so the benefit of mixing is grid interpolation, reaching average precisions uniform quantization cannot realize. translated_title: SemKV：由质量悬崖引导的面向长上下文大语言模型推理的语义混合精度KV缓存量化方法
translated_abstract: 键值缓存是长上下文大语言模型推理中的主要内存瓶颈，其大小随上下文长度线性增长。我们发现，在小数位宽网格上的均匀KV量化并不会平缓地退化：在预先指定的多种子统计协议下，使用仿射量化器的Llama-3.1-8B-Instruct在每位数值低至2.322码位时仍与FP16 KV在统计上无法区分，而在2.0位时性能崩溃——即在(2.0, 2.322]区间存在一个质量悬崖，该悬崖在生成阶段量化和多轮对话场景中重现，并可迁移至Mistral-7B模型。这一悬崖重新定义了重要性感知的混合精度：在悬崖之上，八个模型内部重要性指标在统计上可以互换，因此混合精度的收益在于网格插值，能够达到均匀量化无法实现的平均精度。SemKV保留每一个token，通过模型内部分数对token进行排序，并分配两个相邻的悬崖之上的精度……
tldr: 提出SemKV方法，发现KV缓存量化中存在“质量悬崖”现象（2.322码位以下性能骤降），并据此通过模型内部语义分数对token排序、分配悬崖之上的相邻精度，实现优于均匀量化的混合精度KV缓存压缩，加速长上下文LLM推理。
en_tdlr: SemKV identifies a "quality cliff" in KV cache quantization (collapse below ~2.3 bits/value) and exploits it to guide semantic mixed-precision quantization that ranks tokens by model-internal scores and assigns adjacent above-cliff precisions, achieving compression beyond uniform quantization for long-context LLM inference.
